text: In D231105 the reviewer preferred oAuth2 to mod because the name gives more context about the instance. The checked landing uses oAuth2 for its CardDAV and CalDAV token-module instances, and the fixed CardDAV caller retains that name. This is a scoped naming example for this discovery code; the suggestion was nonblocking and its row remains Not Done. The separate module-getter suggestion was deferred to a follow-up. No authentication or test was run.
title: Use the OAuth role when naming Account Hub module instances
